label: Format Field
description: Format values in a selected field.

fields.message: This step's format is written as "{{trim param.format}}", which is not a known format. Choose one below.

options.label: Trim spaces
options.description: Remove spaces at the start and end.

options.label: Number
options.description: Read the value as a number.

options.label: Date
options.description: Show the value as a date in a set format.

options.label: Leading zeros
options.description: Pad whole numbers with zeros to a width.

fields.label: Decimal places
fields.placeholder: Blank keeps them as they are
fields.help: Rounds to this many places. Leave blank for a plain number.

fields.label: Width (digits)
fields.help: Whole numbers shorter than this get zeros in front. Other values are left as they are.
